segments.title: Cold Open & Hype Train Derailment
segments.notes: Pepito delivers sign-on while ill; Hype Train commandeers feed for 20-month freestyle rap over trap beat, fixating on cheese and month math.

segments.title: Dr. Disrespect Admits to Inappropriate Minor Messages
segments.notes: Blackwell covers Dr. Disrespect's confession to sexting a minor via Twitch Whispers in 2017; Nickmercs condemns him; Blackwell reads statements and contextualizes with prior cheating scandal.

segments.title: Julian Assange Plea Deal via Justin Powers
segments.notes: Blackwell adopts 'Justin Powers' persona (Austin Powers stand-in) to report Assange's Saipan guilty plea, felony count, and return to Australia; Justin Powers declares 'fuck a bogic' catchphrase.

segments.title: Movie Trailer Roundup with Trent
segments.notes: Trent reviews Farming Simulator 25 cinematic, Red One (Santa kidnapping action-comedy), Heretic (A24 horror), and The Penguin HBO series teaser; Blackwell loses red hat mid-segment.

segments.title: Val Kilmer Conspiracy Call-In Test
segments.notes: Blackwell tests 'Colin' call-in system as Guy Redacted; callers include Big J Dub, Kendall (cheese tax), Skymer (red hat/Rock conspiracy), Clementine Verne (ex-correspondent warns of Justin Powers/John Oliver sleeper agent), Mr. Delicious (Val Kilmer CIA/Polybius lore), and a dog claiming Pepito impregnated her.

segments.title: Pepito Neutering Crisis
segments.notes: Blackwell confronts Pepito over canine paternity allegations; Pepito claims dog rules exempt him, then agrees to neutering ('snip snip') under pressure from chat and Blackwell.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein: Hock-Tua, Dr. Disrespect, Val Kilmer & Christian Bale
segments.notes: Trip fields nine street opinions: Joe Hendry fan, Hock-Tua spit physics debate, Captain Rey Mysterio (Pepito defender), birthday dog (Jan 6 alibi), Rob (park permit dispute), Dr. Disrespect impersonator, neutered orange-sack dog, Dr. Disinfect (G4 revival cameo), Val Kilmer (art prints), Cal Vilmer/Christian Bale (Lego Batman method acting).

segments.title: Sign-Off & Elden Ring Transition
segments.notes: Blackwell wraps, notes Kendall sleeping, attempts raid of Dr. Disinfect but anticipates stream crash switching to Elden Ring setup.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchored full broadcast; tested call-in system as Guy Redacted; performed Justin Powers impression; lost red hat during movies.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered cold open while sick; faced live paternity accusations from multiple dogs; agreed to on-air neutering under chat pressure.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Derailed sign-on with 20-month trap freestyle about cheese, month thickness, and 'fuck a bogic' energy.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appeared sick; called into own show to argue for higher cheese tax; hung up after Blackwell conceded.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: correspondent. Presented movie trailer block: Farming Simulator 25, Red One, Heretic, The Penguin.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducted nine street interviews on Hock-Tua, Pepito, Dr. Disrespect, Val Kilmer, and Christian Bale; system glitched mid-segment.

characters.name: Justin Powers
characters.notes: correspondent. Blackwell's Austin Powers stand-in; covered Assange plea deal; introduced 'fuck a bogic' catchphrase; flagged as sleeper agent by Clementine Verne.

characters.name: Guy Redacted
characters.notes: Blackwell's call-in host persona for Colin system test; managed five callers including ex-correspondent Clementine Verne.

characters.name: Clementine Verne
characters.notes: call-in guest. Claimed former BIN correspondent in hiding; warned Justin Powers is John Oliver sleeper agent; requested job from Blackwell.

characters.name: Mr. Delicious
characters.notes: call-in guest. Alleged Val Kilmer recruited by CIA via Polybius arcade game; detailed Kilmer filmography as covert asset timeline.

characters.name: Dr. Disinfect
characters.notes: street interviewee. Claimed G4 revival medical doctor; offered to launder reputation via headphone/GFuel sales; denied touching kids.

characters.name: Val Kilmer
characters.notes: street interviewee. Claimed to be alive selling $500 art prints; teased Conspiracy 2 franchise with Santa and The Rock.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito was sick at broadcast start but recovered mid-stream.
Pepito accused of impregnating multiple dogs; caller claims full litter and lactose-intolerant cheese child support.
Pepito agreed to neutering ('snip snip') after Blackwell pressure; claims dog rules exempt him from human responsibility.
Blackwell tested 'Colin' call-in system (844-721-5277) for upcoming project with Kasim; first live caller was Big J Dub.
Justin Powers introduced as Austin Powers' stand-in 'when Austin's busy'; later accused by Clementine Verne of being John Oliver sleeper agent.
Blackwell lost red hat during movie segment; chat and Skymer distressed; hat not recovered by sign-off.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covered Dr. Disrespect's admission to sexting a minor and Julian Assange's plea deal via Justin Powers' Austin Powers impression, then tested a new call-in system that exposed Pepito's alleged canine paternity scandal and triggered an on-air neutering agreement. The broadcast concluded with Trip Bradstein's chaotic park interviews spanning Hock-Tua spit physics, a Dr. Disrespect impersonator, Val Kilmer selling art prints, and Christian Bale discussing Lego Batman method acting.
